title: Intrinsic Geometry of Stock Market from Graph Ricci Flow Replication Spec
hypothesis: Fully connected positive-curvature correlation graph of NASDAQ-100 develops neckpinch flattening under Ollivier-Ricci flow; surgery on zero-curvature links reveals hierarchical community structure without pruning or assumed k.
sample: Empirical correlation graph of NASDAQ-100 index constituents. Price series from Yahoo! Finance yahoo_fin for tickers listed in wiki_nasdaq. Pearson correlation Cij from returns r_i, distance weight w_ij = sqrt(2(1-Cij)) defines weighted undirected fully connected graph. No filters stated.
method: 1. Retrieve NASDAQ-100 constituent list wiki_nasdaq and daily prices from Yahoo! Finance for 1/1/2020-20/11/2024. Sample period is five years as printed.
2. Compute returns r_i per stock and Pearson correlation matrix Cij = <(r_i - bar r_i)(r_j - bar r_j)>/sigma_i sigma_j .
3. Define edge weight / distance w_ij = sqrt(2(1-Cij)). Graph G=(V,E,w) is fully connected, all w_ij >0.

4. Define discrete Ollivier-Ricci curvature with lazy random walk measure m_x^alpha, alpha=1/2, Wasserstein distance W(m_i,m_j), kappa_ij =1 - W(m_i,m_j)/d(i,j) where d(i,j) is shortest path distance induced by w. Use alpha=1/2 throughout; Lin-Lu-Yau limit limit_{alpha->1} kappa/(1-alpha) = n/(n-1) is theoretical benchmark.

5. Discrete Ricci flow iteration l: w_ij^{(l+1)} = (1- kappa_ij^{(l)}) d^{(l)}(i,j) with w_ij^{(0)}=w_ij, updating all edges simultaneously, recomputing kappa each step. Run for 5, 10 and 20 iterations. Histograms of w and kappa and scatter w vs kappa plotted.

6. Identify neckpinch flattening. Surgery performed along zero-curvature links (kappa = 0) which after 20 iterations have edge weight around 3. This uses theoretical lower bound kappa >= 2/d_i+2/d_j-2 and equal-weight bound 2(3-n)/(n-1) and global bounds -2 and 1 as benchmarks.
7. Hierarchical recursion: apply steps 2-6 to subgraphs obtained by surgery without assumptions on number of clusters.
